snippet.title: 2-3 Years in Grindstan - Game Preview Trailer
snippet.description: 2-3 Years in Grindstan is an Idle 3D RPG where you do the thinking, and your warrior does the bleeding. Manage stats, dump gear and unlock epic skills while your hero bravely does all the dirty work.
